page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.m1.medium is a general-purpose virtual machine instance based on the x86_64 CPU architecture. It features 4 dedicated virtual CPUs and 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding a balanced memory-to-core ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU. The instance runs on the KVM hypervisor, ensuring virtualization-level isolation and dedicated CPU allocation.

This instance does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. It does not feature any integrated graphics processing units or complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The lack of local storage and hardware acceleration represents a tradeoff, positioning this instance for workloads that rely on external storage volumes and standard CPU processing.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation provides predictable performance for standard business applications without the resource contention typical of shared-core or burstable instances. The balanced resource profile makes the ecs.m1.medium suitable for general-purpose workloads, including mid-tier web servers, application hosting, containerized microservices, and development or testing environments.
